description:
## Context

`render_frame/1` (`interactive.ex` L913–916) runs three sequential overlay compositing passes:

```elixir
lines = maybe_composite_model_selector(state, lines)
lines = maybe_composite_dequeue_overlay(state, lines)
lines = maybe_composite_focused_dialog(state, lines)
```

Each function independently checks a different state field, constructs an `%Overlay{}` struct, and calls `Overlay.composite/4` with the same `width`/`height`. In practice at most one overlay is active per frame: `model_selector`, `dequeue_overlay`, and `{:dialog, key}` under `focused_component` are mutually exclusive.

## Implementation

Replace the three passes with a single `composite_active_overlay/2` that pattern-matches state once:

```elixir
defp composite_active_overlay(%{model_selector: ms, width: w, height: h}, lines) when not is_nil(ms) do
  ...
end
defp composite_active_overlay(%{dequeue_overlay: ov, width: w, height: h, theme: theme}, lines) when not is_nil(ov) do
  ...
end
defp composite_active_overlay(%{focused_component: {:dialog, key}} = state, lines) do
  ...
end
defp composite_active_overlay(_state, lines), do: lines
```

Move the overlay construction logic from each `maybe_composite_*` into the matching head. Delete the three old `maybe_composite_*` functions and `render_dialog_overlay/3`.

## Acceptance criteria

- `render_frame/1` contains exactly one overlay compositing call
- The three `maybe_composite_*` functions and `render_dialog_overlay/3` are deleted
- All existing Interactive tests pass
- Model selector, dequeue overlay, and dialog overlays each render correctly (covered by existing tests or new ones if gaps exist)
title: Collapse three overlay compositing passes in render_frame/1 into one
